# Starter milestone templates

Status: templates 1 to 5 approved by Nick on Sep 26, 2026. Template 6 added for his review.

Drafted Sep 26, 2026 from recurring steps in the project logs (active and closed projects).
Every milestone name is 40 characters or fewer. Steps that don't apply to a project can be deleted after the template is applied.
Terms: Infor is the request and contract system. SIVAT is the value analysis committee review. HPG is the group purchasing contract.

## 1. New supply item
Based on Scepter, Celt Closure Device, Asahi wires, and Sasuke/Gaia wires.
1. Physician request confirmed
2. HPG pricing verified
3. Vendor registered in Infor
4. Request entered in Infor
5. SIVAT approved
6. Contract complete in Infor
7. Item numbers assigned
8. PAR levels set
9. First order placed
10. Product on shelf

## 2. Service agreement
For new service agreements and renewals. Based on Siemens, EKOS, and Impella. The steps already fit both cases, so only the name changed.
1. Vendor quote received
2. Entered in Infor
3. Contracts review complete
4. Redlines resolved
5. Agreement signed
6. Coverage confirmed active

## 3. Product trial
Based on HemoSphere, Affera, STARSystem, and the stent trials.
1. Trial request entered in Infor
2. Trial agreement approved
3. Trial supplies ordered
4. Staff education complete
5. Trial go-live
6. Trial complete, supplies returned
7. Physician decision made
8. Purchase request entered or closed

## 4. Capital purchase
Based on Power Injector, EP Lab Headset, and Mavig Shield.
1. Vendor quote received
2. Capital request submitted
3. Funds approved
4. Purchase order issued
5. Equipment delivered
6. Installed and in service

## 5. Rebate or consignment agreement
Based on Crystal rebate, Zilver PTX rebate and consignment, TAVR consignment, and Angiosculpt.
1. Agreement submitted in Infor
2. Usage and PAR levels confirmed
3. Contracts redline complete
4. SIVAT approved
5. Agreement signed
6. Rebate or consignment active

## 6. Software or vendor service
Based on Virtex. VIPER is the review step Virtex went through after legal.
1. Vendor registered in Infor
2. Request entered in Infor
3. Review path confirmed
4. IT PMO request submitted
5. Legal review complete
6. Purchasing redlines complete
7. VIPER review complete
8. Vendor redlines resolved
9. Agreement signed
10. Service live

## Decisions
- Sep 26: Nick approved templates 1 to 5 as drafted and will edit them in the app. "Service agreement renewal" is renamed "Service agreement". Template 6 added at his request.
